Results and interpretation

Both native models use Global Equations. Model A solves two flow states and three accumulators. Model B adds two gel-wall states. The nominal 10 ns pulse is represented by post-activation initial data. Optical heating, nucleation and the activation pressure transient are excluded.

Baseline inputs: available work 2 nJ; initial gas radius 15 µm; chamber radius 30 µm; outlet radius 5 µm; effective inertance length 50 µm; density 1000 kg/m³; ambient pressure 100 kPa; adiabatic exponent 1.4. Connected chamber liquid sets the finite discharge budget. Gel inputs are G = 20 kPa and viscosity 0.010 Pa s. These inputs define the controls. PFC and hydrogel calibration remain unresolved.

Defined output Rigid chamber A Open hydrogel B
Initial chamber overpressure 279.632 kPa 279.632 kPa
Highest first-ejection outlet speed 15.37608 m/s 1.62538 m/s
Highest outlet dynamic-pressure scale 118.2119 kPa 1.3209 kPa
Emitted mass over first ejection 20.96789 ng 0.15612 ng
Emitted energy 1.391345 nJ 0.000136 nJ
Emitted impulse 2.270810e-10 N s 1.982567e-13 N s
First outward ejection duration 33.8850 µs 1.9370 µs
Largest elastic confinement pressure — 9.1430 kPa
Largest one-hemisphere elastic force — 33.7705 µN

The highest sampled outlet speed occurs in A_E5nJ_a3um: 25.27982 m/s. Source overpressure is 512.212 kPa. Outlet dynamic pressure is 319.535 kPa. The family samples work 0.5, 2 and 5 nJ. It samples outlet radii 3, 5 and 10 µm. Initial gas/chamber radii and inertance length stay fixed. These are conditional maxima within the sampled family. A universal limit is not established.

The baseline energy ceiling is 31.91538 m/s. Its dynamic-pressure ceiling is 509.296 kPa. The solution also spends energy on emission and meniscus work. Energy remains in column motion and the source. The solved maximum is therefore below these bounds.

Open-gel peak-speed transmission is 10.5709%. Emitted-energy transmission is 0.00980%. Emitted-impulse transmission is 0.08731%. Integrate outlet fluxes to obtain energy and impulse. Peak-speed ratios cannot replace those integrals. Here gel motion receives energy and shortens the first ejection. General monotonic effects of modulus and viscosity are not established.

The sealed control emits zero mass, energy and impulse. Its maximum elastic pressure is 9.6259 kPa. Its maximum inner-wall stretch is 1.15252. The gel deforms while external discharge remains zero.

The observer diagnostic bounds mean arrest pressure from emitted impulse. It uses outlet area and a 1 µs interval. Peak impact pressure is not established. Missing: contact dynamics, arriving mass, target transmission and gel fracture.

Native verification passed for all 17 cases. Maximum normalized energy residual: 1.260e-07. Maximum native/reference waveform error: 1.152e-04. Maximum pressure-communication diagnostic: 0.08356, below the stipulated 0.1 screen. Both baselines were reloaded and solved in a fresh COMSOL process. Peak velocities passed the 2 ns / 1 ns resolution check. These checks verify the specified implementation and temporal convergence. Experimental validation remains unresolved. Missing: PFC EOS/phase inventory, laser conversion, gel calibration and device geometry.

Models and rebuild

The 53-step guide builds both models from a blank 0D model. It provides inputs, solver settings, stopping rules and output checks. Markdown guide · Input files.

Model A — finite-energy outlet discharge
Model B — gel confinement and outlet transmission

Open the MPH files in COMSOL 6.4. Each includes one component, Global Equations and a transient study. Result tables and time histories are saved. These scalar models need no spatial mesh. Model B's outletOpen selects an existing channel or sealed control.

.\Run-Rebuild.ps1 rebuilds the native case family. .\Run-Verify.ps1 reloads and checks baselines. .\Run-CheckGuide.ps1 checks imports and A-to-B conversion in memory. Install requirements.txt for Python checks. Run python scripts/reference.py and python scripts/verify_results.py. Parameter changes and validity limits appear in README.md.

Complete worked derivation: 29 equation blocks with symbols, assumptions and checks

Two minimal single-event laser-cavitation models

Problem, architecture and scope

Model A calculates source pressure and first-ejection outlet speed. It uses specified source work, gas volume and liquid inventory. It also derives their energy ceilings. Model B adds hydrogel compliance and loss. It calculates gel load and the remaining emitted output.

An initially spherical chamber contains gas and carrier liquid. A liquid outlet already connects it to the surroundings. Initially connected chamber liquid sets the finite discharge budget. Effective channel inertance is a separate input. Model A fixes the chamber wall. Model B surrounds it with intact, undrained spherical hydrogel. Gas expansion enlarges the chamber or displaces liquid through the outlet. The sealed control fixes outlet motion at zero. This architecture describes expansion-driven external ejection. Collapse jets and gel penetration require different models.

A single 10 ns optical pulse is represented by post-activation initial data. Time zero follows activation and pressure equilibration. Optical heating, nucleation and energy conversion are excluded. There is no periodic load. Follow the first outward ejection until speed returns to zero. Stop sooner if liquid exhausts or a validity screen triggers. The sealed control stops at its first wall turning point. Evaluate speed maxima within these episodes. Later collapse and rebound are excluded.

Time starts at the initialized post-activation state. Positive outlet velocity points outward. Discharge coordinate means emitted volume divided by outlet area. Positive radial direction runs from chamber center into gel. Positive wall velocity means expansion. Ambient pressure is constant and absolute. Initially, the wall is stress-free relative to ambient. All initial mechanical velocities are zero. Chamber pressure is uniform. Gas-pocket shape and internal gas/liquid tension are neglected. The external meniscus supplies capillary resistance. Far-field radial stress tends to negative ambient pressure. Far-field displacement decays. The outlet exits at ambient with the specified meniscus pressure. An open case requires an existing channel. The sealed case emits zero liquid.

Constitutive assumptions. The source is a closed adiabatic ideal gas. Its exponent is constant. A PFC-vapor EOS is outside this control. Liquid and undrained gel densities are constant. The column has fixed effective inertance and a finite discharge budget. Gel elasticity is incompressible neo-Hookean with Kelvin–Voigt viscosity. Optional port losses are linear and quadratic. Outlet focusing, free-surface shape, fracture, phase exchange and diffusion remain unresolved. The spherical gel law approximates a chamber with a small outlet. Planar-layer mechanics requires a separate model. Material predictions require calibration.

Start from the first law, volume conservation and unsteady Bernoulli. Add the specified source EOS and spherical gel constitutive model. The course explains mechanisms and finite-energy budgets. Chapters 1–3 and Appendix A supply these model blocks. Brennen, Chapter 2 discusses spherical momentum and polytropic assumptions. The gas-volume coupling, finite-stroke rule and diagnostics are derived here.

Symbol glossary and conventions

All lengths use m, times s, masses kg, pressures Pa, energies J and forces N. Subscripts 0 and ref label initial and unstressed states; g, j, el, cap, dis and obs label gas, emitted jet, elastic, capillary, dissipative and observer quantities. Superscripts on scalar quantities are powers. A dot is a derivative in time. An integral is over the displayed real variable or surface. Absolute value is scalar magnitude. A hat labels the normalized state defined below. The constant pi is dimensionless. Arithmetic has its usual real meaning. No scalar is reused for a different role.

Eq. (E03) — adopted ideal-gas energy and adiabatic first law.

Symbols before Eq. (E03): Ug\mathcal U_gUg​ is internal energy (J); pbp_bpb​ is absolute source pressure (Pa); VgV_gVg​ is gas volume (m³); κ>1\kappa>1κ>1 is the constant ideal-gas exponent; ddd denotes a differential along the closed adiabatic source trajectory.

Ug=pbVgκ−1,dUg=−pb dVg,Vg dpb+pb dVg=−(κ−1)pb dVg.\mathcal U_g=\frac{p_bV_g}{\kappa-1},\qquad d\mathcal U_g=-p_b\,dV_g,\qquad V_g\,dp_b+p_b\,dV_g=-(\kappa-1)p_b\,dV_g.Ug​=κ−1pb​Vg​​,dUg​=−pb​dVg​,Vg​dpb​+pb​dVg​=−(κ−1)pb​dVg​.

The first relation defines the source constitutive model. The second applies its adiabatic first-law balance. Heat and mass exchange vanish after initialization. Differentiate the first relation. Multiply by the exponent minus one to obtain the third. Condensation and further PFC vapor production are excluded.

Collect the differential terms in Eq. (E03). Divide by positive pressure and volume. Integrate from the initial state to fix the constant. Exponentiation gives the pressure law. Expansion lowers pressure. No periodic source is prescribed.

Apply Eq. (E04) at ambient pressure. Take the positive root to find equilibrium volume. Integrate overpressure to define available work. Integrate the volume power, whose exponent differs from one. Evaluate both endpoints and factor the initial volume. Pressure times volume has units J. Numerically invert this monotone relation for initial pressure. Changing the work budget changes the initial state. It adds no later work.

Available work means post-activation mechanical availability. Incident optical energy is a separate quantity. Determine available work from a measured pressure-volume path. Alternatively, use absorbed energy with a supported conversion and phase model. Source mass and phase composition must support the initialized state. Conversion efficiency and PFC EOS remain unspecified.

Eq. (E05a) — uniqueness of the finite-work inversion.

Apply Leibniz differentiation in the first row. The endpoint pressure equals ambient, so its term vanishes. Integrate the remaining positive power for the second row. Equal source and ambient pressures give zero work. Equilibrium-volume terms grow sublinearly at large source pressure. This gives the final limit. Positive available work therefore selects a unique initial pressure.

Step 3 — Accelerate an outlet flow and retain actual emitted output

Column inertia and emitted mass are separate quantities. The meniscus model assumes a pinned hemisphere. Different curvature requires different entry pressure. Measure or fit the linear resistance. Steady Poiseuille resistance needs justification for this short event. The odd-in-speed loss dissipates energy in either direction.

Meniscus pressure stays constant during this episode. Its integral is work against a constant conservative load. The model excludes evolving free-surface energy. Persistent hemispherical curvature during jet formation is not established. Changing curvature, contact-line motion or breakup requires a revised entry model.

Fixed-geometry continuity gives the first velocity profile. The second row applies inviscid streamline Euler momentum. Integrate the fixed profile to obtain inertance. Integrate convection to obtain endpoint kinetic heads. Neglect reservoir inlet speed and retain outlet head. Substitute the continuity area relation in the energy integral. This yields the same inertance length. The approximation represents an existing channel. Free-surface focusing and transverse kinetic energy are excluded. Calibrate effective inertance and loss for the actual geometry.

Integrate the pressure gradient in Eq. (E06a). Add the specified meniscus and dissipative pressure drops. Divide by positive density and inertance length. This gives outlet acceleration. A sealed outlet retains its zero initial speed. The kinetic-head term accounts for energy leaving the outlet.

F(Vg)=Ug(Vg)+p∞(Vg−Vg0),F′(Vg)=p∞−pb,F′′(Vg)=κpb/Vg>0,F(Vg0)−F(Veq)=E0.\mathcal F(V_g)=\mathcal U_g(V_g)+p_\infty(V_g-V_{g0}),\quad \mathcal F'(V_g)=p_\infty-p_b,\quad \mathcal F''(V_g)=\kappa p_b/V_g>0,\quad \mathcal F(V_{g0})-\mathcal F(V_{\mathrm{eq}})=E_0.F(Vg​)=Ug​(Vg​)+p∞​(Vg​−Vg0​),F′(Vg​)=p∞​−pb​,F′′(Vg​)=κpb​/Vg​>0,F(Vg0​)−F(Veq​)=E0​.

The source first law gives the first derivative. Differentiate Eq. (E04) for the second. Strict convexity gives a unique global minimum at ambient pressure. Evaluate the potential difference to obtain Eq. (E05). This establishes the work budget within the adopted control.

Eq. (E22) — separate outlet-speed and emitted-RMS ceilings.

Symbols before Eq. (E22): Kc,Ej,E0K_c,E_j,E_0Kc​,Ej​,E0​ are column kinetic energy, emitted energy and available work (J); mc>0m_c>0mc​>0 is effective column inertia mass (kg); mj>0m_j>0mj​>0 is actual emitted mass (kg); UUU is outlet speed (m/s); UrmsU_{\mathrm{rms}}Urms​ is emitted mass-weighted RMS speed (m/s); qjq_jqj​ is outlet dynamic-pressure scale (Pa); ρ\rhoρ is density (kg/m³); A,LA,LA,L are outlet area and inertance length (m², m); square roots are nonnegative.

Kc+Ej≤E0,∣U∣≤2E0/mc,Urms=2Ej/mj≤2E0/mj,qj=ρU2/2≤E0/(AL).\begin{aligned} K_c+E_j&\le E_0,\qquad |U|\le\sqrt{2E_0/m_c},\\ U_{\mathrm{rms}}&=\sqrt{2E_j/m_j}\le\sqrt{2E_0/m_j},\\ q_j&=\rho U^2/2\le E_0/(AL). \end{aligned}Kc​+Ej​Urms​qj​​≤E0​,∣U∣≤2E0​/mc​​,=2Ej​/mj​​≤2E0​/mj​​,=ρU2/2≤E0​/(AL).​

Every listed receiver energy is nonnegative on the outward branch. Combine Eq. (E18) with the minimum in Eq. (E22a). Isolate column kinetic energy and divide by positive effective mass. This gives the outlet-speed ceiling. Emitted energy and positive emitted mass define the RMS ceiling. Insert column mass from Eq. (E06) for the dynamic-pressure ceiling. The outlet ceiling depends on effective inertance. The emitted-RMS ceiling follows from conservation and specified mass. Liquid exhaustion may stop the trajectory before either ceiling.

A finite energy budget needs a positive mass lower bound. Without it, a universal RMS-speed maximum cannot be computed. A pointwise pressure maximum needs a contact or compression model. Missing: area, duration and load path. Source pressure, outlet dynamic pressure and observer pressure are distinct quantities.

Eq. (E23) — finite emitted impulse and a mean arrest-pressure bound.

Symbols before Eq. (E23): IjI_jIj​ is emitted impulse (N s); mjm_jmj​ is emitted mass (kg); mmm is a dummy cumulative emitted-mass coordinate (kg); U(m)U(m)U(m) is the same outlet-speed history reparameterized by discharged mass (m/s); Ej,E0E_j,E_0Ej​,E0​ are emitted energy and available work (J); AobsA_{\mathrm{obs}}Aobs​ is positive observer area (m²); τobs\tau_{\mathrm{obs}}τobs​ is positive averaging time (s); pˉarrest\bar p_{\mathrm{arrest}}pˉ​arrest​ is mean positive arrest pressure attributable to these emitted parcels (Pa).

Ij2=(∫0mjU(m)dm)2≤(∫0mj1dm)(∫0mjU(m)2dm)=2mjEj≤2mjE0,pˉarrest≤Ij/(Aobsτobs).\begin{aligned} I_j^2&=\left(\int_0^{m_j}U(m)dm\right)^2 \le\left(\int_0^{m_j}1dm\right)\left(\int_0^{m_j}U(m)^2dm\right) =2m_jE_j\le2m_jE_0,\\ \bar p_{\mathrm{arrest}}&\le I_j/(A_{\mathrm{obs}}\tau_{\mathrm{obs}}). \end{aligned}Ij2​pˉ​arrest​​=(∫0mj​​U(m)dm)2≤(∫0mj​​1dm)(∫0mj​​U(m)2dm)=2mj​Ej​≤2mj​E0​,≤Ij​/(Aobs​τobs​).​

Apply Cauchy–Schwarz to the integrable finite speed history. Its two integrals are emitted mass and twice emitted energy. Assume parcels stop without reversal and receive no extra actuation. Their received impulse is then bounded by incoming impulse. Divide by specified area and duration for mean pressure. Defaults are outlet area and one microsecond. Instantaneous impact pressure remains uncomputed. Propagation and water hammer are excluded.

Eq. (E24) — matched single-event transmission measures.

Symbols before Eq. (E24): TU,TE,TI,TqT_U,T_E,T_I,T_qTU​,TE​,TI​,Tq​ are dimensionless ratios; subscripts A,BA,BA,B identify matched rigid and hydrogel cases with the same source state, density and outlet geometry; UA,max⁡,UB,max⁡U_{A,\max},U_{B,\max}UA,max​,UB,max​ are first-event outlet-speed maxima (m/s); Ej,A,Ej,BE_{j,A},E_{j,B}Ej,A​,Ej,B​ are emitted energies accumulated by each event endpoint (J); Ij,A,Ij,BI_{j,A},I_{j,B}Ij,A​,Ij,B​ are emitted impulses (N s); qj,A,max⁡,qj,B,max⁡q_{j,A,\max},q_{j,B,\max}qj,A,max​,qj,B,max​ are first-event dynamic-pressure maxima (Pa); denominators are positive in the rigid reference.

TU=UB,max⁡/UA,max⁡,TE=Ej,B/Ej,A,TI=Ij,B/Ij,A,Tq=qj,B,max⁡/qj,A,max⁡=TU2.T_U=U_{B,\max}/U_{A,\max},\quad T_E=E_{j,B}/E_{j,A},\quad T_I=I_{j,B}/I_{j,A},\quad T_q=q_{j,B,\max}/q_{j,A,\max}=T_U^2.TU​=UB,max​/UA,max​,TE​=Ej,B​/Ej,A​,TI​=Ij,B​/Ij,A​,Tq​=qj,B,max​/qj,A,max​=TU2​.

At equal density, dynamic-pressure ratio equals speed ratio squared. Integrate full histories for emitted energy and impulse. A peak speed cannot determine these integrals. Stop each open case at speed return, inventory exhaustion or validity screen. Matched cases may therefore have different endpoints. These ratios compare finite outputs per shot. They are distinct from frequency-domain transfer functions. Every emitted-output ratio is zero for a sealed channel.

Step 9 — Declare the regime and check its communication rate

Eq. (E25) — communication and Mach diagnostics.

Symbols before Eq. (E25): Cp,Mj,Mw\mathcal C_p,M_j,M_wCp​,Mj​,Mw​ are dimensionless diagnostics; LcommL_{\mathrm{comm}}Lcomm​ is communication length (m), chosen as inertance length for A and the greater of inertance length and chamber diameter for B; cLc_LcL​ is reference speed (m/s); pbp_bpb​ is positive absolute pressure (Pa); p˙b\dot p_bp˙​b​ is its time derivative (Pa/s); κ\kappaκ is dimensionless; Vg,V˙gV_g,\dot V_gVg​,V˙g​ are volume and its rate (m³, m³/s); U,WU,WU,W are speeds (m/s); absolute values denote magnitudes.

Cp=LcommcL∣p˙b∣pb=LcommcLκ∣V˙g∣Vg,Mj=∣U∣cL,Mw=∣W∣cL.\mathcal C_p=\frac{L_{\mathrm{comm}}}{c_L}\frac{|\dot p_b|}{p_b} =\frac{L_{\mathrm{comm}}}{c_L}\frac{\kappa|\dot V_g|}{V_g},\qquad M_j=\frac{|U|}{c_L},\qquad M_w=\frac{|W|}{c_L}.Cp​=cL​Lcomm​​pb​∣p˙​b​∣​=cL​Lcomm​​Vg​κ∣V˙g​∣​,Mj​=cL​∣U∣​,Mw​=cL​∣W∣​.

Logarithmically differentiate Eq. (E04) for the second communication expression. Compare pressure-change and pressure-communication times. No propagation field is solved. The open baseline communication diagnostic stays below 0.1. This is a stipulated screen, whose error bound remains unvalidated. Both Mach diagnostics must also stay below 0.1.

Undrained behavior requires events much shorter than solvent drainage. The course uses an illustrative 30 micrometer drainage scale. Its estimated drainage time is 1.5 s. These events last microseconds. Actual permeability and rate-dependent moduli remain unmeasured. Check small-outlet geometry, positive liquid inventory and intact gel. Check gas breakthrough before the finite stroke ends. The 20% stretch stop is a stipulated deformation screen. Measured fracture strain is missing.

Check the sealed case communication ratio separately. Energy conservation cannot resolve failed pressure communication. A pressure-history prediction requires that screen to pass.

What the completed models can establish

The models provide conditional first-event solutions and maxima. They derive energy ceilings, spherical gel resistance and recoverable work. They also calculate matched finite-output ratios. A universal cavitation maximum is not established. Calibrated PFC limits and the excluded 10 ns activation pressure remain unresolved. Collapse-jet maxima and transmission through intact gel also remain unresolved.

Experimental validation requires post-activation phase volume and pressure. A measured pressure-volume path can supply the source work. Record absorbed pulse energy and conversion evidence. Specify moving liquid mass, outlet geometry and channel status. Measure gel modulus and viscosity at the event strain rate. Measure cavity volume, emitted speed, mass and wall deformation together. Declare comparison locations and averaging intervals. Compare source pressure, dynamic pressure and all four finite-output ratios.

Independent numerical integration, native COMSOL checks and self-audit are distinguished from independent expert review.

结果与解释

两个原生模型使用全局方程（Global Equations）。模型 A 求解两个流动状态及三个累计量。模型 B 加入两个凝胶壁面状态。标称 10 ns 脉冲以激活后初始数据表示。光热、成核与激活压力瞬态不在范围内。

基准输入：可用功 2 nJ；初始气体半径 15 µm；腔室半径 30 µm；出口半径 5 µm；有效惯性长度 50 µm；密度 1000 kg/m³；环境压力 100 kPa；绝热指数 1.4。连通腔室液体决定有限排出量。凝胶输入为 G = 20 kPa、黏度 0.010 Pa s。这些输入定义对照。PFC 与水凝胶校准尚未解决。

两个最简的单次激光诱导空化模型

问题、系统构型与适用范围

模型 A 计算源压力和首次排液的出口速率。输入为给定源功、气体体积和液体存量。它同时推导相应能量上限。模型 B 加入水凝胶顺应性与损耗，计算凝胶载荷和剩余排出量。

初始球形腔室内含气体和载液。已有液体出口将腔室连向外部。初始连通的腔室液体决定有限排出量。通道有效惯性另行指定。模型 A 固定腔壁。模型 B 在腔壁外设置完整、不排水的球形水凝胶。气体膨胀使腔室增大，或将液体经出口排出。密封对照将出口运动设为零。该结构描述膨胀驱动的外部排液。塌缩射流和凝胶穿透需要不同模型。

单次 10 ns 光脉冲以激活后的初始数据表示。零时刻位于激活和压力均衡之后。模型省略光热、成核和能量转换，没有周期载荷。首次向外排液持续至速率回零。液体耗尽或有效性筛查触发时提前停止。密封对照在腔壁首次转向时停止。速度最大值在这些过程中计算。后续塌缩和回弹不在范围内。

时间从激活后的初态开始。出口速度向外为正。排液坐标等于排出体积除以出口面积。径向正方向从腔室中心指向凝胶。腔壁速度为正表示膨胀。环境绝对压力恒定。初始腔壁相对环境无应力，全部机械速度为零。腔室压力均匀。忽略气团形状及内部气液表面张力。外部弯月面提供毛细阻力。远场径向应力趋于负环境压力，位移衰减。出口处为环境压力，并附加给定弯月面压力。开放算例要求已有通道。密封算例排液量为零。

本构假设。 源为封闭绝热理想气体，指数恒定。该对照不采用 PFC 蒸气状态方程。液体和不排水凝胶密度恒定。液柱具有固定有效惯性和有限排出量。凝胶采用不可压缩新胡克弹性及 Kelvin–Voigt 黏性。出口可添加线性及二次损耗。出口聚焦、自由表面形状、断裂、相交换和扩散尚未解决。球形凝胶定律近似带小出口的腔室。平面层力学需要单独模型。材料预测需要校准。

基础为第一定律、体积守恒和非定常伯努利方程。再加入给定源状态方程及球形凝胶本构模型。课程说明机制与有限能量预算。第 1–3 章及附录 A 提供这些模型模块。Brennen，第 2 章讨论球形动量及多方过程假设。气体体积耦合、有限行程规则和诊断量在此推导。

符号表与约定

所有长度以 m 表示，时间以 s 表示，质量以 kg 表示，压力以 Pa 表示，能量以 J 表示，力以 N 表示。下标 0 和 ref 分别表示初始状态与无应力状态；g、j、el、cap、dis 和 obs 分别表示气体、排出射流、弹性、毛细、耗散和观测量。标量上的上标表示幂。上方一点表示对时间求导。积分针对所显示的实变量或表面进行。绝对值表示标量的大小。上方尖帽表示下文定义的归一化状态。常数 pi 无量纲。算术运算采用通常的实数意义。任何标量都不用于两个不同的角色。

步骤 1 — 守恒体积并声明有限源

式 (E01) — 几何恒等式。

式 (E01) 之前的符号定义： AAA 为出口面积（m²）；aaa 为出口半径（m）；Vg0,Vc0,VgV_{g0},V_{c0},V_gVg0​,Vc0​,Vg​ 分别为初始气体、初始腔室和当前气体体积（m³）；Rg0,Rref,RR_{g0},R_{\mathrm{ref}},RRg0​,Rref​,R 分别为初始气体、参考腔室和当前腔室半径（m）；xxx 为排出体积除以面积（m）；LbL_bLb​ 为可排出体积对应的长度（m）；pi 无量纲。

A=πa2,Vg0=4πRg033,Vc0=4πRref33,Vg=Vg0+Ax+4π3(R3−Rref3),Lb=(Vc0−Vg0)/A.\begin{aligned} A&=\pi a^2,\qquad V_{g0}=\frac{4\pi R_{g0}^3}{3},\qquad V_{c0}=\frac{4\pi R_{\mathrm{ref}}^3}{3},\\ V_g&=V_{g0}+Ax+\frac{4\pi}{3}(R^3-R_{\mathrm{ref}}^3),\qquad L_b=(V_{c0}-V_{g0})/A. \end{aligned}AVg​​=πa2,Vg0​=34πRg03​​,Vc0​=34πRref3​​,=Vg0​+Ax+34π​(R3−Rref3​),Lb​=(Vc0​−Vg0​)/A.​

第二行守恒腔室液体体积。气体增加量等于排液体积与腔室扩张体积之和。模型 A 将腔室扩张量设为零。有限液体排出量耗尽时停止。

式 (E02) — 初始数据与允许的向外行程。

式 (E02) 之前的符号定义： x,Rx,Rx,R 为长度（m）；U,WU,WU,W 分别为液体和腔壁速度（m/s）；Rref,LbR_{\mathrm{ref}},L_bRref​,Lb​ 为正的参考半径和可排出体积对应的长度（m）；AAA 为面积（m²）；Vc0,Vg0V_{c0},V_{g0}Vc0​,Vg0​ 为初始体积（m³）；自变量取零表示初始化。

x(0)=0,U(0)=0,R(0)=Rref,W(0)=0,0≤x≤Lb,Ax<Vc0−Vg0.x(0)=0,\quad U(0)=0,\quad R(0)=R_{\mathrm{ref}},\quad W(0)=0, \qquad 0\le x\le L_b,\qquad Ax<V_{c0}-V_{g0}.x(0)=0,U(0)=0,R(0)=Rref​,W(0)=0,0≤x≤Lb​,Ax<Vc0​−Vg0​.

零初始速度是给定的激活后输入。成核不在范围内。有限行程约束排出质量。

式 (E03) — 所采用的理想气体能量与绝热第一定律。

式 (E03) 之前的符号定义： Ug\mathcal U_gUg​ 为内能（J）；pbp_bpb​ 为绝对源压力（Pa）；VgV_gVg​ 为气体体积（m³）；κ>1\kappa>1κ>1 为恒定的理想气体指数；ddd 表示沿封闭绝热源轨迹的微分。

Ug=pbVgκ−1,dUg=−pb dVg,Vg dpb+pb dVg=−(κ−1)pb dVg.\mathcal U_g=\frac{p_bV_g}{\kappa-1},\qquad d\mathcal U_g=-p_b\,dV_g,\qquad V_g\,dp_b+p_b\,dV_g=-(\kappa-1)p_b\,dV_g.Ug​=κ−1pb​Vg​​,dUg​=−pb​dVg​,Vg​dpb​+pb​dVg​=−(κ−1)pb​dVg​.

第一式定义源本构模型。第二式应用绝热第一定律。初始化后无热量及质量交换。对第一式求微分，再乘以指数减一，得到第三式。凝结及后续 PFC 蒸气生成不在范围内。

式 (E04) — 积分压力定律。

式 (E04) 之前的符号定义： pb,p0p_b,p_0pb​,p0​ 为正的当前和初始绝对压力（Pa）；Vg,Vg0V_g,V_{g0}Vg​,Vg0​ 为正的当前和初始体积（m³）；κ>1\kappa>1κ>1 无量纲；ln⁡\lnln 是无量纲比值的对数；ddd 为沿轨迹的微分。

Vg dpb=−κpb dVg,dpbpb=−κdVgVg,ln⁡pbp0=−κln⁡VgVg0,pb=p0(Vg0Vg)κ.\begin{aligned} V_g\,dp_b&=-\kappa p_b\,dV_g,\\ \frac{dp_b}{p_b}&=-\kappa\frac{dV_g}{V_g},\\ \ln\frac{p_b}{p_0}&=-\kappa\ln\frac{V_g}{V_{g0}},\\ p_b&=p_0\left(\frac{V_{g0}}{V_g}\right)^\kappa. \end{aligned}Vg​dpb​pb​dpb​​lnp0​pb​​pb​​=−κpb​dVg​,=−κVg​dVg​​,=−κlnVg0​Vg​​,=p0​(Vg​Vg0​​)κ.​

整理式 (E03) 的微分项。除以正压力和正体积。从初态积分以确定常数。取指数得到压力定律。膨胀降低压力。没有给定周期源。

步骤 2 — 计算有限功预算

式 (E05) — 环境平衡与可用膨胀功。

式 (E05) 之前的符号定义： Veq,Vg0V_{\mathrm{eq}},V_{g0}Veq​,Vg0​ 为气体体积（m³）；p0>p∞>0p_0>p_\infty>0p0​>p∞​>0 分别为初始源与环境的绝对压力（Pa）；κ>1\kappa>1κ>1 无量纲；E0E_0E0​ 为可用绝热膨胀功（J）；vvv 为正的气体体积哑变量（m³）；积分沿预先声明的压力—体积路径进行。

p∞=p0(Vg0/Veq)κ⟹Veq=Vg0(p0/p∞)1/κ,E0=∫Vg0Veq[p0(Vg0v)κ−p∞]dv=p0Vg0κ[v1−κ1−κ]Vg0Veq−p∞(Veq−Vg0)=p0Vg0κ−1[1−(Vg0Veq)κ−1]−p∞(Veq−Vg0).\begin{aligned} p_\infty&=p_0(V_{g0}/V_{\mathrm{eq}})^\kappa \quad\Longrightarrow\quad V_{\mathrm{eq}}=V_{g0}(p_0/p_\infty)^{1/\kappa},\\ E_0&=\int_{V_{g0}}^{V_{\mathrm{eq}}} \left[p_0\left(\frac{V_{g0}}v\right)^\kappa-p_\infty\right]dv\\ &=p_0V_{g0}^\kappa\left[\frac{v^{1-\kappa}}{1-\kappa}\right]_{V_{g0}}^{V_{\mathrm{eq}}} -p_\infty(V_{\mathrm{eq}}-V_{g0})\\ &=\frac{p_0V_{g0}}{\kappa-1} \left[1-\left(\frac{V_{g0}}{V_{\mathrm{eq}}}\right)^{\kappa-1}\right] -p_\infty(V_{\mathrm{eq}}-V_{g0}). \end{aligned}p∞​E0​​=p0​(Vg0​/Veq​)κ⟹Veq​=Vg0​(p0​/p∞​)1/κ,=∫Vg0​Veq​​[p0​(vVg0​​)κ−p∞​]dv=p0​Vg0κ​[1−κv1−κ​]Vg0​Veq​​−p∞​(Veq​−Vg0​)=κ−1p0​Vg0​​[1−(Veq​Vg0​​)κ−1]−p∞​(Veq​−Vg0​).​

在环境压力下应用式 (E04)。取正根得到平衡体积。积分超压定义可用功。对体积幂积分；其指数不等于一。代入两端点，再提出初始体积。压力乘体积的单位为 J。数值反演此单调关系，得到初始压力。改变功预算即改变初态，后续无功输入。

可用功指激活后的机械可用能。入射光能另行定义。用测得的压力—体积路径确定可用功；或结合吸收能量及有依据的转换、相态模型。源质量和相组成必须支持给定初态。转换效率与 PFC 状态方程仍未指定。

式 (E05a) — 有限可用功反演的唯一性。

式 (E05a) 之前的符号定义： E0E_0E0​ 为可用功（J）；p0>p∞p_0>p_\inftyp0​>p∞​ 分别为初始和环境压力（Pa）；Vg0,Veq,vV_{g0},V_{\mathrm{eq}},vVg0​,Veq​,v 分别为初始、平衡和哑变量气体体积（m³）；κ>1\kappa>1κ>1 无量纲；∂/∂p0\partial/\partial p_0∂/∂p0​ 表示保持初始体积、环境压力和指数不变的偏导数；lim⁡\limlim 表示所指定的压力极限。

∂E0∂p0=∫Vg0Veq(Vg0/v)κdv+[p0(Vg0/Veq)κ−p∞]∂Veq∂p0=Vg0κ−1[1−(Vg0/Veq)κ−1]>0,E0∣p0=p∞=0,lim⁡p0→∞E0p0=Vg0κ−1.\begin{aligned} \frac{\partial E_0}{\partial p_0} &=\int_{V_{g0}}^{V_{\mathrm{eq}}}(V_{g0}/v)^\kappa dv +[p_0(V_{g0}/V_{\mathrm{eq}})^\kappa-p_\infty]\frac{\partial V_{\mathrm{eq}}}{\partial p_0}\\ &=\frac{V_{g0}}{\kappa-1}[1-(V_{g0}/V_{\mathrm{eq}})^{\kappa-1}]>0,\\ E_0\big|_{p_0=p_\infty}&=0,\qquad \lim_{p_0\to\infty}\frac{E_0}{p_0}=\frac{V_{g0}}{\kappa-1}. \end{aligned}∂p0​∂E0​​E0​​p0​=p∞​​​=∫Vg0​Veq​​(Vg0​/v)κdv+[p0​(Vg0​/Veq​)κ−p∞​]∂p0​∂Veq​​=κ−1Vg0​​[1−(Vg0​/Veq​)κ−1]>0,=0,p0​→∞lim​p0​E0​​=κ−1Vg0​​.​

第一行应用莱布尼茨求导。端点压力等于环境压力，故端点项为零。积分剩余正幂函数，得到第二行。源压等于环境压力时，可用功为零。高源压下，平衡体积项以次线性增长，得到最后极限。因此，正可用功唯一确定初始压力。

步骤 3 — 加速出口流动并保留实际排出输出

式 (E06) — 惯性、毛细阻力与出口损失。

式 (E06) 之前的符号定义： mcm_cmc​ 为液柱有效惯性质量（kg）；ρ\rhoρ 为载液密度（kg/m³）；AAA 为出口面积（m²）；L,aL,aL,a 分别为流体惯性长度和出口半径（m）；pcap,plossp_{\mathrm{cap}},p_{\mathrm{loss}}pcap​,ploss​ 为压力（Pa）；σ\sigmaσ 为表面张力（N/m）；R≥0\mathcal R\ge0R≥0 为经拟合的阻力（Pa s/m）；Ko≥0K_o\ge0Ko​≥0 无量纲；UUU 为出口速度（m/s）；绝对值表示大小。

mc=ρAL,pcap=2σ/a,ploss=RU+ρKoU∣U∣/2.m_c=\rho AL,\qquad p_{\mathrm{cap}}=2\sigma/a,\qquad p_{\mathrm{loss}}=\mathcal R U+\rho K_oU|U|/2.mc​=ρAL,pcap​=2σ/a,ploss​=RU+ρKo​U∣U∣/2.

液柱惯性和排出质量分别定义。弯月面假定为接触线固定的半球。不同曲率需要不同入口压力。线性阻力应测量或拟合。短时过程采用稳态泊肃叶阻力需要依据。关于速度为奇函数的压降在两个方向均耗散能量。

本过程的弯月面压力恒定。其积分为克服恒定保守载荷的功。模型不计算演化的自由表面能。射流形成时持续保持半球曲率尚未建立。曲率变化、接触线运动或破碎需要修改入口模型。

式 (E06a) — 推导流体惯性与流出的动能压头。

式 (E06a) 之前的符号定义： z,zi,zoz,z_i,z_oz,zi​,zo​ 分别为流线坐标和入口/出口位置（m）；u(z,t)u(z,t)u(z,t) 为局部速度，U(t)U(t)U(t) 为出口速度（m/s）；f(z)f(z)f(z) 为固定的无量纲剖面；A,A(z)A,\mathcal A(z)A,A(z) 分别为出口和局部面积（m²）；LLL 为流体惯性长度（m）；ρ\rhoρ 为密度（kg/m³）；p(z,t)p(z,t)p(z,t) 为压力（Pa）；ttt 为时间（s）；∂t,∂z\partial_t,\partial_z∂t​,∂z​ 为固定位置的偏导数；上方一点表示时间导数。大储液腔近似将入口速度设为零，将出口剖面值设为一。

u(z,t)=f(z)U(t),f(z)=A/A(z),L=∫zizof(z)dz,ρ(∂tu+u∂zu)=−∂zp,∫zizo(∂tu+u∂zu)dz=LU˙+[u2/2]zizo=LU˙+U2/2,12ρ∫zizoA(z)u2dz=12ρAU2∫zizof(z)dz=12ρALU2.\begin{aligned} u(z,t)&=f(z)U(t),\quad f(z)=A/\mathcal A(z),\quad L=\int_{z_i}^{z_o}f(z)dz,\\ \rho(\partial_tu+u\partial_zu)&=-\partial_zp,\\ \int_{z_i}^{z_o}(\partial_tu+u\partial_zu)dz &=L\dot U+[u^2/2]_{z_i}^{z_o}=L\dot U+U^2/2,\\ \frac12\rho\int_{z_i}^{z_o}\mathcal A(z)u^2dz &=\frac12\rho AU^2\int_{z_i}^{z_o}f(z)dz=\frac12\rho ALU^2. \end{aligned}u(z,t)ρ(∂t​u+u∂z​u)∫zi​zo​​(∂t​u+u∂z​u)dz21​ρ∫zi​zo​​A(z)u2dz​=f(z)U(t),f(z)=A/A(z),L=∫zi​zo​​f(z)dz,=−∂z​p,=LU˙+[u2/2]zi​zo​​=LU˙+U2/2,=21​ρAU2∫zi​zo​​f(z)dz=21​ρALU2.​

固定几何连续性给出第一行速度分布。第二行应用无黏流线欧拉动量方程。积分固定分布得到惯性。积分对流项得到端点动能压头。忽略储液腔入口速度，保留出口压头。在能量积分中代入连续性面积关系，得到相同惯性长度。该近似描述已有通道。自由表面聚焦和横向动能不在范围内。有效惯性与损耗应针对真实几何校准。

式 (E07) — 非定常伯努利方程与显式出口标志。

式 (E07) 之前的符号定义： xxx 为排出体积除以出口面积（m）；UUU 为向外的出口速度（m/s）；上方一点表示时间导数；bob_obo​ 为开放/密封标志；ρ\rhoρ 为密度（kg/m³）；LLL 为流体惯性长度（m）；pb,p∞,pcap,plossp_b,p_\infty,p_{\mathrm{cap}},p_{\mathrm{loss}}pb​,p∞​,pcap​,ploss​ 分别为源、环境、弯月面和耗散压力（Pa）。

pb−p∞−pcap−ploss=ρLU˙+ρU2/2(bo=1),x˙=boU,U˙=boρL(pb−p∞−pcap−ploss−ρU2/2).\begin{aligned} p_b-p_\infty-p_{\mathrm{cap}}-p_{\mathrm{loss}}&=\rho L\dot U+\rho U^2/2\quad(b_o=1),\\ \dot x&=b_oU,\qquad \dot U=\frac{b_o}{\rho L}(p_b-p_\infty-p_{\mathrm{cap}}-p_{\mathrm{loss}}-\rho U^2/2). \end{aligned}pb​−p∞​−pcap​−ploss​x˙​=ρLU˙+ρU2/2(bo​=1),=bo​U,U˙=ρLbo​​(pb​−p∞​−pcap​−ploss​−ρU2/2).​

积分式 (E06a) 的压力梯度。加入给定弯月面压降与耗散压降。除以正密度和正惯性长度，得到出口加速度。密封出口保持零初始速度。动能压头项计入离开出口的能量。

式 (E08) — 液柱储能与耗散功率。

式 (E08) 之前的符号定义： Kc,EcapK_c,E_{\mathrm{cap}}Kc​,Ecap​ 为储存能量（J）；mcm_cmc​ 为有效惯性质量（kg）；UUU 为出口速度（m/s）；pcap,pb,p∞p_{\mathrm{cap}},p_b,p_\inftypcap​,pb​,p∞​ 为压力（Pa）；AAA 为面积（m²）；xxx 为排出体积除以面积（m）；PportP_{\mathrm{port}}Pport​ 为耗散功率（W）；R\mathcal RR 为阻力（Pa s/m）；ρ\rhoρ 为密度（kg/m³）；Ko,boK_o,b_oKo​,bo​ 无量纲；d/dtd/dtd/dt 为时间导数。

Kc=mcU2/2,Ecap=pcapAx,Pport=boA(RU2+ρKo∣U∣3/2)≥0,ddt(Kc+Ecap)=boA(pb−p∞)U−Pport−boρAU3/2.\begin{aligned} K_c&=m_cU^2/2,\qquad E_{\mathrm{cap}}=p_{\mathrm{cap}}Ax,\\ P_{\mathrm{port}}&=b_oA(\mathcal R U^2+\rho K_o|U|^3/2)\ge0,\\ \frac{d}{dt}(K_c+E_{\mathrm{cap}})&=b_oA(p_b-p_\infty)U-P_{\mathrm{port}}-b_o\rho AU^3/2. \end{aligned}Kc​Pport​dtd​(Kc​+Ecap​)​=mc​U2/2,Ecap​=pcap​Ax,=bo​A(RU2+ρKo​∣U∣3/2)≥0,=bo​A(pb​−p∞​)U−Pport​−bo​ρAU3/2.​

对储能求导并代入式 (E07)。加入弯月面功以抵消弯月面压力项。耗散压降乘体积流率给出耗散功率。最后的动能压头项给出排出功率。液柱储能与不可逆损失分别保留。

式 (E08a) — 有限的排出质量、动能与冲量。

式 (E08a) 之前的符号定义： mjm_jmj​ 为排出质量（kg）；EjE_jEj​ 为排出动能（J）；IjI_jIj​ 为排出的轴向冲量（N s）；ρ\rhoρ 为密度（kg/m³）；AAA 为面积（m²）；xxx 为排出体积除以面积（m）；UUU 为非负的出口速度（m/s）；bob_obo​ 为出口标志；上方一点表示时间导数，自变量取零表示初始化。

mj=ρAx,E˙j=boρAU3/2,I˙j=boρAU2,Ej(0)=Ij(0)=0.m_j=\rho Ax,\quad \dot E_j=b_o\rho AU^3/2,\quad \dot I_j=b_o\rho AU^2,\quad E_j(0)=I_j(0)=0.mj​=ρAx,E˙j​=bo​ρAU3/2,I˙j​=bo​ρAU2,Ej​(0)=Ij​(0)=0.

质量流率乘比动能，得到排出功率。质量流率乘轴向速度，得到排出冲量变化率。各变化率对时间积分。液柱能量与动量描述瞬时存储。排出能量与冲量描述已排出的量。

步骤 4 — 只保留约束所需的凝胶力学

式 (E09) — 不可压缩球形映射与主伸长比。

式 (E09) 之前的符号定义： r,s,R,Rrefr,s,R,R_{\mathrm{ref}}r,s,R,Rref​ 分别为当前材料半径、参考材料半径、当前腔壁半径和参考腔壁半径（m）；λr,λt\lambda_r,\lambda_tλr​,λt​ 为无量纲的径向和切向伸长比；∂r/∂s\partial r/\partial s∂r/∂s 表示固定时间的微分；r≥R>0r\ge R>0r≥R>0 且 s≥Rref>0s\ge R_{\mathrm{ref}}>0s≥Rref​>0。

r3−R3=s3−Rref3,3r2∂r∂s=3s2,λr=s2r2,λt=rs,λrλt2=1.\begin{aligned} r^3-R^3&=s^3-R_{\mathrm{ref}}^3,\\ 3r^2\frac{\partial r}{\partial s}&=3s^2,\\ \lambda_r&=\frac{s^2}{r^2},\qquad\lambda_t=\frac rs,\qquad \lambda_r\lambda_t^2=1. \end{aligned}r3−R33r2∂s∂r​λr​​=s3−Rref3​,=3s2,=r2s2​,λt​=sr​,λr​λt2​=1.​

令腔壁外参考体积与当前材料体积相等。对映射求导得到第二行。径向、切向长度比给出第三行。它们的乘积检查局部体积守恒。

Trr=−χ+Gλr2,Ttt=−χ+Gλt2,Ttt−Trr=G[(r/s)2−(s/r)4],dTrrdr=2r(Ttt−Trr).\begin{aligned} T_{rr}&=-\chi+G\lambda_r^2,\qquad T_{tt}=-\chi+G\lambda_t^2,\\ T_{tt}-T_{rr}&=G[(r/s)^2-(s/r)^4],\\ \frac{dT_{rr}}{dr}&=\frac2r(T_{tt}-T_{rr}). \end{aligned}Trr​Ttt​−Trr​drdTrr​​​=−χ+Gλr2​,Ttt​=−χ+Gλt2​,=G[(r/s)2−(s/r)4],=r2​(Ttt​−Trr​).​

第一行是采用的本构定律。应力相减以消去约束压力。第三行给出球形弹性平衡。积分得到弹性阻力。下文另行加入径向惯性和黏性。

pel=2G∫R∞[(r/s)2−(s/r)4]drr,β3=1−R3−Rref3r3,drr=β2 dβ1−β3,[(r/s)2−(s/r)4]drr=1−β61−β3 dβ=(1+β3)dβ,pel=2G∫Rref/R1(1+β3)dβ=2G[β+β4/4]Rref/R1=G2[5−4RrefR−(RrefR)4].\begin{aligned} p_{\mathrm{el}}&=2G\int_R^\infty[(r/s)^2-(s/r)^4]\frac{dr}{r},\\ \beta^3&=1-\frac{R^3-R_{\mathrm{ref}}^3}{r^3},\quad \frac{dr}{r}=\frac{\beta^2\,d\beta}{1-\beta^3},\\ [(r/s)^2-(s/r)^4]\frac{dr}{r} &=\frac{1-\beta^6}{1-\beta^3}\,d\beta=(1+\beta^3)d\beta,\\ p_{\mathrm{el}}&=2G\int_{R_{\mathrm{ref}}/R}^{1}(1+\beta^3)d\beta =2G[\beta+\beta^4/4]_{R_{\mathrm{ref}}/R}^{1}\\ &=\frac G2\left[5-4\frac{R_{\mathrm{ref}}}{R}-\left(\frac{R_{\mathrm{ref}}}{R}\right)^4\right]. \end{aligned}pel​β3[(r/s)2−(s/r)4]rdr​pel​​=2G∫R∞​[(r/s)2−(s/r)4]rdr​,=1−r3R3−Rref3​​,rdr​=1−β3β2dβ​,=1−β31−β6​dβ=(1+β3)dβ,=2G∫Rref​/R1​(1+β3)dβ=2G[β+β4/4]Rref​/R1​=2G​[5−4RRref​​−(RRref​​)4].​

积分式 (E10) 的应力差。在固定腔壁半径下对体积映射求微分。代入得到第三行。平方差因式分解，再约去公因子。壁面端点为参考半径除以当前半径。远场端点为一。积分多项式，再代入两端点。最后两行恢复附录 A 的式 (A-E05)，无需波场。

式 (E12) 之前的符号定义： WgW_gWg​ 为弹性功（J）；GGG 为剪切模量（Pa）；R,Rref,ξR,R_{\mathrm{ref}},\xiR,Rref​,ξ 分别为当前腔壁、参考腔壁和哑变量腔壁半径（m）；pel(ξ)p_{\mathrm{el}}(\xi)pel​(ξ) 为式 (E11) 在哑变量半径处求得的压力（Pa）；pi 无量纲。

Wg=4π∫RrefRpel(ξ)ξ2dξ=2πG∫RrefR(5ξ2−4Rrefξ−Rref4ξ−2)dξ=2πG[5ξ33−2Rrefξ2+Rref4ξ]RrefR=2πG[5R33−2RrefR2+Rref4R−2Rref33].\begin{aligned} W_g&=4\pi\int_{R_{\mathrm{ref}}}^{R}p_{\mathrm{el}}(\xi)\xi^2d\xi\\ &=2\pi G\int_{R_{\mathrm{ref}}}^{R} (5\xi^2-4R_{\mathrm{ref}}\xi-R_{\mathrm{ref}}^4\xi^{-2})d\xi\\ &=2\pi G\left[\frac{5\xi^3}{3}-2R_{\mathrm{ref}}\xi^2+\frac{R_{\mathrm{ref}}^4}{\xi}\right]_{R_{\mathrm{ref}}}^{R}\\ &=2\pi G\left[\frac{5R^3}{3}-2R_{\mathrm{ref}}R^2+\frac{R_{\mathrm{ref}}^4}{R}-\frac{2R_{\mathrm{ref}}^3}{3}\right]. \end{aligned}Wg​​=4π∫Rref​R​pel​(ξ)ξ2dξ=2πG∫Rref​R​(5ξ2−4Rref​ξ−Rref4​ξ−2)dξ=2πG[35ξ3​−2Rref​ξ2+ξRref4​​]Rref​R​=2πG[35R3​−2Rref​R2+RRref4​​−32Rref3​​].​

pel(Rref)=0,Wg(Rref)=0,dpeldR=2G(RrefR2+Rref4R5)>0,dWgdR=4πR2pel,pel(Rref+δR)=4GδRRref+O(GδR2/Rref2),Wg(Rref+δR)=8πGRrefδR2+O(GδR3),lim⁡R/Rref→∞pel=52G.\begin{aligned} p_{\mathrm{el}}(R_{\mathrm{ref}})&=0,\qquad W_g(R_{\mathrm{ref}})=0,\\ \frac{dp_{\mathrm{el}}}{dR}&=2G\left(\frac{R_{\mathrm{ref}}}{R^2}+\frac{R_{\mathrm{ref}}^4}{R^5}\right)>0,\qquad \frac{dW_g}{dR}=4\pi R^2p_{\mathrm{el}},\\ p_{\mathrm{el}}(R_{\mathrm{ref}}+\delta R)&=4G\frac{\delta R}{R_{\mathrm{ref}}}+O(G\delta R^2/R_{\mathrm{ref}}^2),\\ W_g(R_{\mathrm{ref}}+\delta R)&=8\pi G R_{\mathrm{ref}}\delta R^2+O(G\delta R^3),\qquad \lim_{R/R_{\mathrm{ref}}\to\infty}p_{\mathrm{el}}=\frac52G. \end{aligned}pel​(Rref​)dRdpel​​pel​(Rref​+δR)Wg​(Rref​+δR)​=0,Wg​(Rref​)=0,=2G(R2Rref​​+R5Rref4​​)>0,dRdWg​​=4πR2pel​,=4GRref​δR​+O(GδR2/Rref2​),=8πGRref​δR2+O(GδR3),R/Rref​→∞lim​pel​=25​G.​

代入无应力半径以检查参考状态。对功求导以检查表面力。泰勒展开给出正小应变刚度与二次储能。半径比趋于无穷时，压力达到平台，功仍随体积增长。耐损伤能力和有效射流形成尚未建立。

Kg=∫R∞12ρg(R2Wr2)24πr2dr=2πρgR4W2[−1r]R∞=2πρgR3W2,pres=pel+4ηgWR,Pgel=16πηgRW2≥0.\begin{aligned} K_g&=\int_R^\infty\frac12\rho_g\left(\frac{R^2W}{r^2}\right)^2 4\pi r^2dr =2\pi\rho_gR^4W^2\left[-\frac1r\right]_R^\infty =2\pi\rho_gR^3W^2,\\ p_{\mathrm{res}}&=p_{\mathrm{el}}+\frac{4\eta_gW}{R},\qquad P_{\mathrm{gel}}=16\pi\eta_gRW^2\ge0. \end{aligned}Kg​pres​​=∫R∞​21​ρg​(r2R2W​)24πr2dr=2πρg​R4W2[−r1​]R∞​=2πρg​R3W2,=pel​+R4ηg​W​,Pgel​=16πηg​RW2≥0.​

体积映射给出径向速度。平方后得到收敛的径向平方反比积分。采用附录 Kelvin–Voigt 系数，见式 (A-E09)–(A-E12)。黏性阻碍腔壁双向运动，耗散功率非负。辐射与波场损耗不在范围内。

式 (E15) 之前的符号定义： R,WR,WR,W 分别为腔壁半径和速度（m, m/s）；上方一点表示时间导数；ρg\rho_gρg​ 为密度（kg/m³）；pb,p∞,pelp_b,p_\infty,p_{\mathrm{el}}pb​,p∞​,pel​ 为压力（Pa）；ηg\eta_gηg​ 为黏度（Pa s）；Kg,WgK_g,W_gKg​,Wg​ 为能量（J）；PgelP_{\mathrm{gel}}Pgel​ 为功率（W）；pi 无量纲。

R˙=W,ρg(RW˙+32W2)=pb−p∞−pel−4ηgWR,dKgdt=2πρg(3R2W3+2R3WW˙)=4πR2W ρg(RW˙+32W2),ddt(Kg+Wg)=4πR2W(pb−p∞)−Pgel.\begin{aligned} \dot R&=W,\qquad \rho_g\left(R\dot W+\frac32W^2\right)=p_b-p_\infty-p_{\mathrm{el}}-\frac{4\eta_gW}{R},\\ \frac{dK_g}{dt}&=2\pi\rho_g(3R^2W^3+2R^3W\dot W) =4\pi R^2W\,\rho_g\left(R\dot W+\frac32W^2\right),\\ \frac{d}{dt}(K_g+W_g)&=4\pi R^2W(p_b-p_\infty)-P_{\mathrm{gel}}. \end{aligned}R˙dtdKg​​dtd​(Kg​+Wg​)​=W,ρg​(RW˙+23​W2)=pb​−p∞​−pel​−R4ηg​W​,=2πρg​(3R2W3+2R3WW˙)=4πR2Wρg​(RW˙+23​W2),=4πR2W(pb​−p∞​)−Pgel​.​

第一行采用不排水球形动量平衡。初始弹性超压为零。对式 (E14) 的动能应用乘积求导。代入腔壁运动学关系，得到第二行。第一行乘体积变化率。代入式 (E13) 的弹性功及式 (E14) 的黏性功率，得到第三行。模型 A 固定半径，径向动能和弹性储能均为零。

Fhem=∫0π/2pelcos⁡θ 2πR2sin⁡θ dθ=2πR2pel[sin⁡2θ2]0π/2=πR2pel.F_{\mathrm{hem}}=\int_0^{\pi/2}p_{\mathrm{el}}\cos\theta\,2\pi R^2\sin\theta\,d\theta =2\pi R^2p_{\mathrm{el}}\left[\frac{\sin^2\theta}{2}\right]_0^{\pi/2} =\pi R^2p_{\mathrm{el}}.Fhem​=∫0π/2​pel​cosθ2πR2sinθdθ=2πR2pel​[2sin2θ​]0π/2​=πR2pel​.

此力是一半球上的方向合力。完整球面因对称性而合力为零。积分整球压力大小得到不同量。靶面区域需要单独指定面积与载荷路径。

V˙g=boAU+4πR2W,D˙=Pport+Pgel,D(0)=0.\dot V_g=b_oAU+4\pi R^2W,\qquad \dot D=P_{\mathrm{port}}+P_{\mathrm{gel}},\qquad D(0)=0.V˙g​=bo​AU+4πR2W,D˙=Pport​+Pgel​,D(0)=0.

对式 (E01) 求导，代入两个运动学关系。出口与凝胶分别运动，其耗散功率相加。

ddt(Ug+p∞Vg+Kc+Kg+Wg+Ecap+D+Ej)=(−pb+p∞)V˙g+(pb−p∞)(boAU+4πR2W)=0.\begin{aligned} \frac{d}{dt}(\mathcal U_g+p_\infty V_g+K_c+K_g+W_g+E_{\mathrm{cap}}+D+E_j) &=(-p_b+p_\infty)\dot V_g+(p_b-p_\infty)(b_oAU+4\pi R^2W)\\ &=0. \end{aligned}dtd​(Ug​+p∞​Vg​+Kc​+Kg​+Wg​+Ecap​+D+Ej​)​=(−pb​+p∞​)V˙g​+(pb​−p∞​)(bo​AU+4πR2W)=0.​

εE=pbVg/(κ−1)−p0Vg0/(κ−1)+p∞(Vg−Vg0)+Kc+Kg+Wg+Ecap+D+EjE0.\varepsilon_E= \frac{p_bV_g/(\kappa-1)-p_0V_{g0}/(\kappa-1)+p_\infty(V_g-V_{g0})+K_c+K_g+W_g+E_{\mathrm{cap}}+D+E_j}{E_0}.εE​=E0​pb​Vg​/(κ−1)−p0​Vg0​/(κ−1)+p∞​(Vg​−Vg0​)+Kc​+Kg​+Wg​+Ecap​+D+Ej​​.

从式 (E18) 减去初始储能，再归一化。保留凝胶动能及弹性储能。接近零的残差检查数值守恒。状态方程与几何校准需要独立证据。

步骤 7 — 将方程映射到原生 COMSOL 状态

式 (E20) — 归一化定义。

τ=Rref/Us,Is=mcUs,x^=x/Lb,U^=U/Us,R^=R/Rref,W^=W/Us,D^=D/E0,E^j=Ej/E0,I^j=Ij/Is.\begin{aligned} \tau&=R_{\mathrm{ref}}/U_s,\qquad I_s=m_cU_s,\\ \widehat x&=x/L_b,\quad\widehat U=U/U_s,\quad\widehat R=R/R_{\mathrm{ref}},\quad\widehat W=W/U_s,\\ \widehat D&=D/E_0,\qquad\widehat E_j=E_j/E_0,\qquad\widehat I_j=I_j/I_s. \end{aligned}τxD​=Rref​/Us​,Is​=mc​Us​,=x/Lb​,U=U/Us​,R=R/Rref​,W=W/Us​,=D/E0​,Ej​=Ej​/E0​,Ij​=Ij​/Is​.​

归一化改变尺度，模型不变。原生状态为 qq、vv、rr、ww、dd、ee、ii。模型 A 省略两个径向状态，剩余五个标量。模型 B 使用七个。三个状态累积损失、排出能量及排出冲量。

式 (E21) — 在物理时间中积分的无量纲残差。

式 (E21) 之前的符号定义： 所有带尖帽的状态均无量纲；其上方一点表示对物理时间求导（1/s）；τ\tauτ 为时间（s）；bob_obo​ 为出口标志；U,W,UsU,W,U_sU,W,Us​ 为速度（m/s）；L,Lb,R,RrefL,L_b,R,R_{\mathrm{ref}}L,Lb​,R,Rref​ 为长度（m）；ρ,ρg\rho,\rho_gρ,ρg​ 为密度（kg/m³）；pb,p∞,pcap,ploss,pelp_b,p_\infty,p_{\mathrm{cap}},p_{\mathrm{loss}},p_{\mathrm{el}}pb​,p∞​,pcap​,ploss​,pel​ 为压力（Pa）；ηg\eta_gηg​ 为黏度（Pa s）；Pport,PgelP_{\mathrm{port}},P_{\mathrm{gel}}Pport​,Pgel​ 为功率（W）；E0E_0E0​ 为功（J）；AAA 为面积（m²）；IsI_sIs​ 为冲量尺度（N s）。

0=τ(x^˙−boU/Lb),0=τ[U^˙−bo(pb−p∞−pcap−ploss−ρU2/2)ρLUs],0=τ(R^˙−W/Rref),0=τ[W^˙−(pb−p∞−pel−4ηgW/R)/ρg−3W2/2RUs],0=τ[D^˙−(Pport+Pgel)/E0],0=τ(E^j˙−boρAU3/(2E0)),0=τ(I^j˙−boρAU2/Is).\begin{aligned} 0&=\tau(\dot{\widehat x}-b_oU/L_b),\\ 0&=\tau\left[\dot{\widehat U}-\frac{b_o(p_b-p_\infty-p_{\mathrm{cap}}-p_{\mathrm{loss}}-\rho U^2/2)}{\rho LU_s}\right],\\ 0&=\tau(\dot{\widehat R}-W/R_{\mathrm{ref}}),\\ 0&=\tau\left[\dot{\widehat W}-\frac{(p_b-p_\infty-p_{\mathrm{el}}-4\eta_gW/R)/\rho_g-3W^2/2}{RU_s}\right],\\ 0&=\tau[\dot{\widehat D}-(P_{\mathrm{port}}+P_{\mathrm{gel}})/E_0],\\ 0&=\tau(\dot{\widehat E_j}-b_o\rho AU^3/(2E_0)),\\ 0&=\tau(\dot{\widehat I_j}-b_o\rho AU^2/I_s). \end{aligned}0000000​=τ(x˙−bo​U/Lb​),=τ[U˙−ρLUs​bo​(pb​−p∞​−pcap​−ploss​−ρU2/2)​],=τ(R˙−W/Rref​),=τ[W˙−RUs​(pb​−p∞​−pel​−4ηg​W/R)/ρg​−3W2/2​],=τ[D˙−(Pport​+Pgel​)/E0​],=τ(Ej​˙​−bo​ρAU3/(2E0​)),=τ(Ij​˙​−bo​ρAU2/Is​).​

将式 (E20) 代入运动及累计方程。速度导数与累计量分别除以对应尺度。每行乘时间尺度。全部残差无量纲。模型 A 固定腔壁，并省略径向两行。气体总体积决定代数源压力。

步骤 8 — 约束已定义的速度、排出输出与压力观测量

式 (E22a) — 证明源机械势的最小值。

式 (E22a) 之前的符号定义： F\mathcal FF 为源内能加上对环境做功，并以初始体积为参考（J）；Ug\mathcal U_gUg​ 为内能（J）；p∞,pbp_\infty,p_bp∞​,pb​ 为正的压力（Pa）；Vg,Vg0,VeqV_g,V_{g0},V_{\mathrm{eq}}Vg​,Vg0​,Veq​ 为体积（m³）；κ>1\kappa>1κ>1 无量纲；E0E_0E0​ 为可用功（J）；导数均针对正的气体体积。

F(Vg)=Ug(Vg)+p∞(Vg−Vg0),F′(Vg)=p∞−pb,F′′(Vg)=κpb/Vg>0,F(Vg0)−F(Veq)=E0.\mathcal F(V_g)=\mathcal U_g(V_g)+p_\infty(V_g-V_{g0}),\quad \mathcal F'(V_g)=p_\infty-p_b,\quad \mathcal F''(V_g)=\kappa p_b/V_g>0,\quad \mathcal F(V_{g0})-\mathcal F(V_{\mathrm{eq}})=E_0.F(Vg​)=Ug​(Vg​)+p∞​(Vg​−Vg0​),F′(Vg​)=p∞​−pb​,F′′(Vg​)=κpb​/Vg​>0,F(Vg0​)−F(Veq​)=E0​.

源第一定律给出一阶导数。对式 (E04) 求导得到二阶导数。严格凸性使环境压力状态成为唯一全局最小值。计算势差得到式 (E05)，建立采用模型中的功预算。

式 (E22) — 区分出口速度与排出均方根速度的上限。

式 (E22) 之前的符号定义： Kc,Ej,E0K_c,E_j,E_0Kc​,Ej​,E0​ 分别为液柱动能、排出动能和可用功（J）；mc>0m_c>0mc​>0 为有效液柱惯性质量（kg）；mj>0m_j>0mj​>0 为实际排出质量（kg）；UUU 为出口速度（m/s）；UrmsU_{\mathrm{rms}}Urms​ 为排出液体按质量加权的均方根速度（m/s）；qjq_jqj​ 为出口动压尺度（Pa）；ρ\rhoρ 为密度（kg/m³）；A,LA,LA,L 分别为出口面积和流体惯性长度（m², m）；平方根取非负值。

Kc+Ej≤E0,∣U∣≤2E0/mc,Urms=2Ej/mj≤2E0/mj,qj=ρU2/2≤E0/(AL).\begin{aligned} K_c+E_j&\le E_0,\qquad |U|\le\sqrt{2E_0/m_c},\\ U_{\mathrm{rms}}&=\sqrt{2E_j/m_j}\le\sqrt{2E_0/m_j},\\ q_j&=\rho U^2/2\le E_0/(AL). \end{aligned}Kc​+Ej​Urms​qj​​≤E0​,∣U∣≤2E0​/mc​​,=2Ej​/mj​​≤2E0​/mj​​,=ρU2/2≤E0​/(AL).​

向外分支中的各接收能量均非负。结合式 (E18) 与式 (E22a) 的最小值。分离液柱动能，再除以正有效质量，得到出口速率上限。排出能量与正排出质量定义均方根速率上限。代入式 (E06) 的液柱质量，得到动压上限。出口上限依赖有效惯性。排出均方根上限来自守恒和给定质量。液体耗尽可能使轨迹提前终止。

有限能量预算需要正的质量下界。缺少该下界时，无法计算普适均方根速率最大值。逐点压力最大值需要接触或压缩模型。缺少：面积、持续时间和载荷路径。源压力、出口动压和观测压力是不同量。

式 (E23) — 有限排出冲量与平均制动压力上界。

式 (E23) 之前的符号定义： IjI_jIj​ 为排出冲量（N s）；mjm_jmj​ 为排出质量（kg）；mmm 为累积排出质量坐标的哑变量（kg）；U(m)U(m)U(m) 为按排出质量重新参数化的同一出口速度历史（m/s）；Ej,E0E_j,E_0Ej​,E0​ 分别为排出动能与可用功（J）；AobsA_{\mathrm{obs}}Aobs​ 为正的观测面积（m²）；τobs\tau_{\mathrm{obs}}τobs​ 为正的平均时间（s）；pˉarrest\bar p_{\mathrm{arrest}}pˉ​arrest​ 为这些排出液体微团所贡献的平均正制动压力（Pa）。

Ij2=(∫0mjU(m)dm)2≤(∫0mj1dm)(∫0mjU(m)2dm)=2mjEj≤2mjE0,pˉarrest≤Ij/(Aobsτobs).\begin{aligned} I_j^2&=\left(\int_0^{m_j}U(m)dm\right)^2 \le\left(\int_0^{m_j}1dm\right)\left(\int_0^{m_j}U(m)^2dm\right) =2m_jE_j\le2m_jE_0,\\ \bar p_{\mathrm{arrest}}&\le I_j/(A_{\mathrm{obs}}\tau_{\mathrm{obs}}). \end{aligned}Ij2​pˉ​arrest​​=(∫0mj​​U(m)dm)2≤(∫0mj​​1dm)(∫0mj​​U(m)2dm)=2mj​Ej​≤2mj​E0​,≤Ij​/(Aobs​τobs​).​

对可积有限速度历史应用柯西–施瓦茨不等式。两个积分分别为排出质量与排出能量的两倍。假定液体微团停止且不反向，也无额外驱动。接收冲量受入射冲量约束。除以指定面积和时长，得到平均压力。默认值为出口面积和一微秒。瞬时冲击压力未计算。传播与水锤不在范围内。

式 (E24) — 匹配的单次过程传导指标。

式 (E24) 之前的符号定义： TU,TE,TI,TqT_U,T_E,T_I,T_qTU​,TE​,TI​,Tq​ 为无量纲比值；下标 A,BA,BA,B 表示源状态、密度和出口几何相同的匹配刚性算例与水凝胶算例；UA,max⁡,UB,max⁡U_{A,\max},U_{B,\max}UA,max​,UB,max​ 为首次过程的出口速度最大值（m/s）；Ej,A,Ej,BE_{j,A},E_{j,B}Ej,A​,Ej,B​ 为各自过程终点时累积的排出动能（J）；Ij,A,Ij,BI_{j,A},I_{j,B}Ij,A​,Ij,B​ 为排出冲量（N s）；qj,A,max⁡,qj,B,max⁡q_{j,A,\max},q_{j,B,\max}qj,A,max​,qj,B,max​ 为首次过程的动压最大值（Pa）；刚性参考算例中的各个分母均为正。

TU=UB,max⁡/UA,max⁡,TE=Ej,B/Ej,A,TI=Ij,B/Ij,A,Tq=qj,B,max⁡/qj,A,max⁡=TU2.T_U=U_{B,\max}/U_{A,\max},\quad T_E=E_{j,B}/E_{j,A},\quad T_I=I_{j,B}/I_{j,A},\quad T_q=q_{j,B,\max}/q_{j,A,\max}=T_U^2.TU​=UB,max​/UA,max​,TE​=Ej,B​/Ej,A​,TI​=Ij,B​/Ij,A​,Tq​=qj,B,max​/qj,A,max​=TU2​.

相同密度下，动压比等于速度比平方。排出能量和冲量需积分完整历史。峰值速度无法确定这些积分。各开放算例在速率回零、存量耗尽或筛查触发时停止。匹配算例终点因此可以不同。各比值比较单次激发的有限输出，区别于频域传递函数。密封通道的各排出比值均为零。

步骤 9 — 声明适用区间并检查压力均衡传播速率

式 (E25) — 压力均衡传播与马赫数诊断。

式 (E25) 之前的符号定义： Cp,Mj,Mw\mathcal C_p,M_j,M_wCp​,Mj​,Mw​ 为无量纲诊断量；LcommL_{\mathrm{comm}}Lcomm​ 为压力均衡传播长度（m），模型 A 取流体惯性长度，模型 B 取流体惯性长度与腔室直径中的较大值；cLc_LcL​ 为参考速度（m/s）；pbp_bpb​ 为正的绝对压力（Pa）；p˙b\dot p_bp˙​b​ 为其时间导数（Pa/s）；κ\kappaκ 无量纲；Vg,V˙gV_g,\dot V_gVg​,V˙g​ 分别为体积及其变化率（m³, m³/s）；U,WU,WU,W 为速度（m/s）；绝对值表示大小。

Cp=LcommcL∣p˙b∣pb=LcommcLκ∣V˙g∣Vg,Mj=∣U∣cL,Mw=∣W∣cL.\mathcal C_p=\frac{L_{\mathrm{comm}}}{c_L}\frac{|\dot p_b|}{p_b} =\frac{L_{\mathrm{comm}}}{c_L}\frac{\kappa|\dot V_g|}{V_g},\qquad M_j=\frac{|U|}{c_L},\qquad M_w=\frac{|W|}{c_L}.Cp​=cL​Lcomm​​pb​∣p˙​b​∣​=cL​Lcomm​​Vg​κ∣V˙g​∣​,Mj​=cL​∣U∣​,Mw​=cL​∣W∣​.

对式 (E04) 作对数微分，得到第二个传播表达式。比较压力变化与压力均衡传播时间。模型不求解传播场。开放基准的传播诊断量低于 0.1。该值为规定筛查限值，误差上界尚未验证。两个马赫诊断量也需低于 0.1。

不排水近似要求事件远短于溶剂排水时间。课程对示例 30 微米尺度估计排水时间为 1.5 s。此处事件持续微秒。实际渗透率及速率相关模量仍未测量。检查小出口几何、正液体存量及完整凝胶。检查有限行程结束前是否气体贯通。20% 伸长停止条件是规定的变形筛查。缺少实测断裂应变。

单独检查密封算例的传播比。能量守恒无法解决压力传播筛查失败。压力历史预测需要通过该筛查。

完成的模型能够确定什么

模型给出条件性的首次过程解和最大值。它们推导能量上限、球形凝胶阻力及可恢复功，并计算匹配有限输出比。普适空化最大值尚未建立。校准后的 PFC 极限及省略的 10 ns 激活压力尚未解决。塌缩射流最大值和完整凝胶穿透也尚未解决。

实验验证需要激活后的相体积与压力。实测压力—体积路径可给出源功。记录吸收脉冲能量与转换依据。指定运动液体质量、出口几何及通道状态。测量事件应变率下的凝胶模量和黏度。同次测量空腔体积、排出速度、质量与腔壁变形。声明比较位置及平均时间窗。比较源压力、动压和全部四个有限输出比。

独立数值积分、原生 COMSOL 检查与自审，与独立专家评审分别记录。
